Toyota Mirai2 manufacturer https://newsroom.toyota.eu/introducing-the-all-new-toyota-mirai/; AKASOL AKASYSTEM15OEM37PRC May2021 https://www.act-news.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/210525_LowRes_AK_Datenblatt_AKASystem_15-OEM-37-PRC_2021_2159x2794mm_EN.pdf; Dai2018 Table8 https://publications.anl.gov/anlpubs/2018/10/146906.pdf. Match complete physical pack mass and nominal energy, not the changing BEV MIX. Car reference44.6kg/1.2432kWh (=310.8V*4Ah/1000),31.5kW for10seconds; truck reference238kg/25kWh,36kW continuous charge,50kW continuous RMS discharge,150kW10second discharge. Retain existing vehicle capacities/power sizing and lifetime replacement counts. These manufacturer ratings are NOT inferred from chemistry or treated as continuous pulse ratings. Material split remains an engineering proxy:70percent cells, as in the truck sizing source; assume the same70percent for cars. NMC622 cell manufacturing is a bulk-composition proxy, NOT a measured Mirai/AKASOL cell design or a validated high-power electrode/capacity recipe. Thus mass-equivalence is corrected while chemistry-specific metal intensities remain uncertain. Sensitivity cell share50-80percent and alternative documented high-power chemistries. One4.518kg central-control/protection assembly per reference pack; remaining mass is allocated using public Dai non-electronic hardware proportions. Car air-cooled reference excludes liquid coolant; unknown fan/duct design is embedded in the residual housing proxy, not independently validated. Truck liquid cooling retains Dai50/50 glycol/water proportions; pump/thermal ratings remain gaps. No module electronics are added on top of the central package; missing distributed monitoring is a coverage gap. All retained material inputs use100percent assembly retention reference; generic working services additional. Equal negative used-battery treatment equals complete manufactured reference mass, including controls, once; no duplicated control waste. These dedicated capacity providers are deliberately outside generic chemistry-density and MIX updates, preserving the already-declared fixed2020 FCEV hardware assumption through2050. Do not interpret corrected mass as a validated manufacturer BOM, annual procurement or primary/secondary content.

Toyota Mirai2 manufacturer https://newsroom.toyota.eu/introducing-the-all-new-toyota-mirai/; AKASOL AKASYSTEM15OEM37PRC May2021 https://www.act-news.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/210525_LowRes_AK_Datenblatt_AKASystem_15-OEM-37-PRC_2021_2159x2794mm_EN.pdf; Dai2018 Table8 https://publications.anl.gov/anlpubs/2018/10/146906.pdf. Match complete physical pack mass and nominal energy, not the changing BEV MIX. Car reference44.6kg/1.2432kWh (=310.8V*4Ah/1000),31.5kW for10seconds; truck reference238kg/25kWh,36kW continuous charge,50kW continuous RMS discharge,150kW10second discharge. Retain existing vehicle capacities/power sizing and lifetime replacement counts. These manufacturer ratings are NOT inferred from chemistry or treated as continuous pulse ratings. Material split remains an engineering proxy:70percent cells, as in the truck sizing source; assume the same70percent for cars. NMC622 cell manufacturing is a bulk-composition proxy, NOT a measured Mirai/AKASOL cell design or a validated high-power electrode/capacity recipe. Thus mass-equivalence is corrected while chemistry-specific metal intensities remain uncertain. Sensitivity cell share50-80percent and alternative documented high-power chemistries. One4.518kg central-control/protection assembly per reference pack; remaining mass is allocated using public Dai non-electronic hardware proportions. Car air-cooled reference excludes liquid coolant; unknown fan/duct design is embedded in the residual housing proxy, not independently validated. Truck liquid cooling retains Dai50/50 glycol/water proportions; pump/thermal ratings remain gaps. No module electronics are added on top of the central package; missing distributed monitoring is a coverage gap. All retained material inputs use100percent assembly retention reference; generic working services additional. Equal negative used-battery treatment equals complete manufactured reference mass, including controls, once; no duplicated control waste. These dedicated capacity providers are deliberately outside generic chemistry-density and MIX updates, preserving the already-declared fixed2020 FCEV hardware assumption through2050. Do not interpret corrected mass as a validated manufacturer BOM, annual procurement or primary/secondary content.
